Berkeley County

Berkeley County stretches from the Charleston metro's northern suburbs to rural farmland along Lake Moultrie, with Moncks Corner as county seat and Goose Creek and Hanahan as its largest cities. Growth is driven by industrial expansion tied to the Naval Weapons Station, a Google data center, and the Volvo Cars plant near Ridgeville, pulling new residential subdivisions north from Charleston along the I-26 corridor.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 23, 2026
